tips_en: Start with Show-Harness (Paper 1) as it offers the most immediate practical impact—89% zero-shot robot control via a clean semantic action interface—and its use of foundation VLMs for embodied tasks provides a useful anchor for connecting to the other two. Paper 2 (OPRD) complements it nicely from a training perspective, addressing how to transfer gains between models of different capacities without imposing a ceiling. Paper 3 (CombatStateBench) extends the VLM-centric theme into interactive video worlds, showing a parallel architectural insight: separating explicit state evolution from generative rendering mirrors Show-Harness's decoupling of semantic decision-making from low-level control.
tips_zh: 建议优先阅读 Show-Harness（论文1），因为它在实际应用中影响最直接——通过简洁的语义动作接口实现了 89% 的零样本机器人控制效果，并且其利用基础 VLM 完成具身任务的设计思路，能很好地串联起另外两篇论文。论文2（OPRD）从训练角度形成互补，探讨如何在不同容量模型间迁移能力而不被弱教师的天花板限制。论文3（CombatStateBench）将 VLM 核心思路拓展到交互式视频世界，其将显式状态演化与生成式渲染解耦的架构洞见，与 Show-Harness 将语义决策与底层控制分离的设计理念相呼应。
